name: Station-bus supervisory interface
summary: Carries the documented station-level monitoring and control data distinct from the process measurement stream.
description: Carries the documented station-level monitoring and control data distinct from the process measurement stream. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Station IED data” at the input and “Station supervisory communications” at the output. Process bus and station bus have different functions.
